newsitem.title: POLAND: ITI GROUP TO SEEK WARSAW BOURSE LISTING IN 1998.
newsitem.headline: ITI GROUP TO SEEK WARSAW BOURSE LISTING IN 1998.

text.p: ITI Holdings SA, a Luxembourg -based parent company of the Polish multi-media and snacks producer ITI Group, will start Luxembourg bourse trading next month and eyes Warsaw listing in 1998, ITI said in a statement.
It said shares in ITI Holdings have been approved following an increase in capital by $35 million through a private equity placement which valued the company at $130 million.
The business of ITI Group includes snack foods production, advertising and commrcials production, theatrical and home video distribution.
The group, in a joint-venture with Central European Media Enterprises, is also active in regional television broadcasting in southern Poland.
The statement said ITI Group and its joint-venture partners expect to invest more than $100 million in the Polish entertainment and television industries over the next three years.
Jan Wejchert, the majority shareholder of ITI Holdings told Reuters the company planned to enter the Warsaw Stock Exchange in mid-1998.
"At that time we should have several of our planned ventures underway," Wejchert said.
ITI netted $3.3 million on sales of $64.6 million in 1995.
